question: Does a physically sourced nonlinear Josephson current-phase law independently select a constitutive response consistent with the positive UD hidden-star quartic?
assumptions: Ideal lumped lossless, zero-current-bias Josephson junction with Ic,C and physical turning amplitude a<pi
BIPM SI h and e and conventional EJ(1-cos(phi)) law; independent of prior UD phase target
Additional bridge r3=kappa*a² with kappa>0, and tau0=2/omega0 calibrated at zero amplitude
Previously considered UD Hstar=||x||²/2+lambda*r3²/4 with lambda>=0; PR87 phase009 unmerged read-only
physical_mapping: HYPOTHESIS only: single Josephson physical phase/action oscillator to UD hidden two-plane; native J action, register/port scale and energy conversion not derived. Physical test NOT_EXECUTED.
target_exposure: Physical source fixes cosine sign without UD target; previously exposed UD g3=3/2/positive lambda known before comparison. Ic=100nA C=100fF are nonmeasured design inputs, not data fits.
fitted_choices: tau0=2/omega0 chosen to match linear frequency; kappa>0 free; optional equal-magnitude hardening λκ=1/16 is comparison design only.
Allowing negative λκ=-1/16 would import/backsolve the known physical sign, not select a native UD coefficient.
sources: https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0082197 (2022 experimentally fitted DC-bias plasma data; not zero-bias amplitude sweep)
baseline: Ordinary zero-biased ideal Josephson circuit with independent Ic and C; exact elliptic frequency curve; no UD extra prediction.
result: EXACT/CONDITIONAL Josephson relative-frequency function AGM(1,cos(a/2))<1 for 0<a<pi; positive hidden-star UD relative frequency 1+lambda*kappa*a² >=1 when lambda>=0,kappa>0. Sign mismatch for this bridge; conventional JJ fully accounts for the physical law. No observed data. JJ002 source audit: 13.28GHz/8.36uA jointly fitted; inferred total C3.6485pF is not an independent prediction. No peak-amplitude measurement/heldout residual. Physical comparison NOT_EXECUTED.
next_discriminant: Obtain raw zero-bias amplitude-frequency pairs, independent parameter/covariance calibration and frozen physical mapping before a held-out UD-versus-Josephson null.
reopening_conditions: A separately sourced native constitutive law with independently fixed parameters and physical map or new physical benchmark data plus distinguishable held-out response.
